body.name: Exact-support latent feedback class \(\mathfrak M_{\mathcal I}(G)\)
body.construction: \(\{(B,(P_{\varepsilon_i})_{i\in V}):\operatorname{supp}(B)=E(G),\; \det(Q_{V\setminus S,V\setminus S})\ne0\; \forall S\in\mathcal I,\; (P_{\varepsilon_i})_{i\in V}\text{ are independent, centered, non-Gaussian, nondegenerate, and have finite second moments, and interventions are surgical}\}\).
